text:
maya: Heads-up — we need to coordinate a new telemetry sidecar for Private/VPC installs. Goal: push runtime + infra metrics out of customer VPCs into the Redwood telemetry-collector with customer-managed KMS and audit hooks. Need firewall/egress constraints and UX for console dashboards.

ben: +1. Which transport do we expect customers to open? full outbound to telemetry.redwood-internal:443, or narrow IP ranges? Also push vs pull? :eyes:

alex: Prefer TLS push on 443 to avoid extra firewall rules. Sidecar should support backoff and local buffering. If customer prefers no outbound to our hosts, we can support S3-compatible presigned uploads (S3 endpoint over 443) as alternative.

maya: Good call. For default we assume outbound to telemetry.redwood-internal:443 (TLS, mTLS optional). Alternate path: s3-upload with presigned POST. We need a minimal whitelist for customers that want to allow only our collector IPs.

ben: For whitelist example: customer ops asked for CIDR list. We can provide an AS/CR IP bundle but prefer FQDN + port 443. Example iptables snippet they can paste: ```
# allow egress to telemetry collector
-A OUTPUT -p tcp -d telemetry-collector.redwood.internal --dport 443 -m state --state NEW,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT
```
(They likely run host-based or cloud NSGs — we'll give both forms.)

sarah: Security notes: KMS must be customer-managed (CMK) when requested. We need explicit KMS ARN template and a rotation policy. Also audit hooks: customers will push audit events to their SIEM; we must expose the audit log webhooks and include signed metadata about KMS key id and rotation events. Sample KMS ARN: `arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789`. We need an HLD for approval.

alex: Sidecar config prototype (YAML) — keeps it minimal for firewall docs: ```
telemetry:
  mode: push  # push | s3
  endpoint: https://telemetry-collector.redwood.internal/v1/ingest
  tls:
    min_version: TLS1.2
    client_cert: /var/run/sidecar/client.crt  # optional mTLS
  buffer_size_mb: 50
  retry_policy:
    initial_backoff_s: 2
    max_backoff_s: 120
```

kevin: For dashboards/console we need to agree on metric naming & labels now. Suggested metric set: `redwood.runtime.request.count`, `redwood.runtime.tokens.generated`, `redwood.runtime.latency.p50`, `redwood.runtime.latency.p95`, `redwood.runtime.kv_cache.hits`. Labels: `model`, `route`, `deployment_id`, `customer_id` (if allowed). We should also include `cost_estimate_usd` for per-route cost tagging.

maya: Agree on metric names. Security: flag that `customer_id` is PII in some contexts — ensure we support redaction. We'll note that in the HLD.

telemetry-bot: Runbook created: "sidecar-telemetry-export" — https://internal.ops/runbooks/sidecar-telemetry-export (created by maya)

ben: One more firewall example for cloud NSG (Azure/AWS SG): ```
# AWS SG rule (egress)
Type: HTTPS
Protocol: TCP
PortRange: 443
Destination: telemetry-collector.redwood.internal (resolve to IPs)
Description: allow egress for telemetry sidecar
```

sarah: Audit hook details: sidecar must sign each batch with key derived from CMK and include the signature header `X-Redwood-Audit-Sig`. We'll need a short-term signing key per sidecar and KMS to sign the public key blob. Also require admins provide an allowlist for where audit logs may be forwarded from sidecar (local SIEM endpoints).

maya: Proposed rollout: alpha with 2 on-prem customers (one AWS VPC, one bare-metal) -> collect firewall edge cases -> beta with 10 customers -> GA. Timeline: alpha week of 1765600000 (2 weeks). Owners: ben for firewall docs, alex for sidecar build, sarah for KMS/audit HLD, kevin for metric schema + console mapping.

ben: Action items: I'll draft the whitelist doc with both FQDN-first and CIDR fallback, include the ipset script and SG examples. ETA: 3 business days.

alex: I'll add S3-presigned path and buffering tests. ETA: next Wed.

sarah: I'll produce the KMS ARNs template and required IAM policy excerpt. Quick snippet for KMS Grant we expect: ```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Principal": {"Service": "sidecar.redwood.internal"},
    "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
    "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:REGION:ACCOUNT:key/KEY-ID"
  }]
}
```

kevin: I'll stub the dashboard mapping and sample eval queries for latency and KV hit rate. Will post the console mock next week.

maya: Thanks all. Let's sync in the weekly infra sync and I'll post the HLD draft by EOD today. :+1:

ben: ack.

alex: ack.

sarah: ack.
